The following views are documented from the NewsHub source code.

Views and API endpoints for the NewsHub application.

This module contains authentication, article, newsletter, publisher, subscription, dashboard, and REST API views.

news.views.approve_article(request, article_id)

Approve an article, notify all relevant subscribers and log the approval.

news.views.article_create(request)

Allow a journalist to submit an article for approval.

news.views.article_delete(request, article_id)

Allow a journalist to delete their own unapproved article.

news.views.article_detail(request, article_id)

Display an approved article or a pending article owned by its author.

news.views.article_edit(request, article_id)

Allow a journalist to edit their own article.

news.views.article_list(request)

List approved articles.

news.views.editor_article_delete(request, article_id)

Allow an editor to delete any article.

news.views.editor_article_detail(request, article_id)

Allow an editor to view an article, including pending articles.

news.views.editor_article_edit(request, article_id)

Allow an editor to update any article.

news.views.editor_dashboard(request)

Give editors access to all article and newsletter management.

news.views.editor_newsletter_delete(request, newsletter_id)

Allow an editor to delete any newsletter.

news.views.editor_newsletter_edit(request, newsletter_id)

Allow an editor to update any newsletter.

news.views.home(request)

Display approved articles and the latest newsletters.

news.views.journalist_dashboard(request)

Display content owned by the logged-in journalist.

news.views.newsletter_create(request)

Allow a journalist to create a newsletter.

news.views.newsletter_delete(request, pk)

Allow a journalist to delete their own newsletter.

news.views.newsletter_detail(request, newsletter_id)

Display a newsletter and its approved articles.

news.views.newsletter_edit(request, newsletter_id)

Allow a journalist to edit their own newsletter.

news.views.newsletter_list(request)

List newsletters.

news.views.publisher_create(request)

Allow a publisher account to create a publisher profile.

news.views.publisher_dashboard(request)

Display articles and newsletters for the current publisher account.

news.views.publisher_delete(request, publisher_id)

Allow a publisher owner to delete its publisher profile.

news.views.publisher_detail(request, publisher_id)

Display a publisher and its approved articles.

news.views.publisher_edit(request, publisher_id)

Allow a publisher owner to update its profile and staff.

news.views.publisher_list(request)

Display all publishers.

news.views.register(request)

Register a user and sign them in.
